attempt: Put the executable-page VirtualProtect call inside assert(...) in an optimized native dispatch test fixture.
reason_failed: Assertions were disabled by the effective compiler configuration, so the side-effecting protection change did not execute. Calling the generated dispatcher from a non-executable page caused access violation before the dispatcher behavior was tested.
error_signature: Exit -1073741819 (access violation) at first generated-code invocation; same test passed with assertions explicitly enabled.
conditions: Required setup is embedded in an assertion
Optimized test compilation may disable assertions
workaround: Explicitly undefine NDEBUG before including assert.h in this fixture; never assume optimized native test assertions execute. Required production setup is outside assertions.
